description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableLabel class, including tests for immutability, equality, and validation of label string length.

classes.name: ImmutableLabelTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableLabel class, validating immutability, equality, and proper handling of label length constraints.

methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations of ImmutableLabel.
